Common alarm display word; each bit 1 displays its alarm. x0 E-STOP active: reset required; x1 Scrubber tripped: reset required; x2 Scrubber trip: high pressure; x3 Scrubber trip: very high level; x4 Scrubber high level (LSH-102); x5 Scrubber drain time limit reached
BR01 alarm display word; each bit 1 displays its alarm. x0 BR01 burner lockout; x1 BR01 temperature input fault; x2 BR01 RUN not received; x3 BR01 RUN without request; x4 TK01 level too low for BR01
BR02 alarm display word; each bit 1 displays its alarm. x0 BR02 burner lockout; x1 BR02 temperature input fault; x2 BR02 RUN not received; x3 BR02 RUN without request; x4 TK02 level too low for BR02
